title: deploy-manifest v1 (deploy.json)
description: How an application is deployed by the Open Atlas Deployer: its release, its components and their sources, and its env file. Kept by the Deployer, never in the application's repository. Format v1, decided by the owner 2026-10-30 (D28); see docs/proposals/deploy-manifest-v1.md.

appliesFrom.description: First app version this manifest applies to; it covers versions up to the next manifest's appliesFrom.

release.description: Where versions come from. {version} in any pattern below is replaced by the version being deployed.

manifest.description: File at the tag holding version, provides and requires.

bundle.description: Release asset whose contents the file paths of non-image components resolve in. Absent: they resolve in the repository at the release tag.

file.description: Env file name on the server, relative to the deploy root; the Deployer is its only writer.

schema.description: Path of the app's own .env.example the file is validated against (in the bundle or at the tag).

template.description: Path of an env template the Deployer keeps (templates/<app>.env.example in the Deployer repository), for apps whose repository has none; reviewed at each new version.

secrets.description: Keys stored encrypted and shown masked.

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub, or a Bitbucket project/repo.

checksums.description: Checksum file inside the asset, checked before use.

image.description: A pinned image reference: a tag that is not latest, or a digest.

registry.description: A registry registered in the Deployer (harbor, ghcr).

image.description: Repository name under the registry, without a tag.

build.description: Present when the Deployer builds the image from the git tag and pushes it; absent when the project's own pipeline pushes it.

host.description: Default host port; an environment may override it.

path.description: Host path relative to the app directory; an environment may override it.

file.description: A file from the bundle or tag mounted read-only (config, init scripts).

keep.description: Holds data that must be backed up and survives redeploys.

service.description: Service name in the app's compose fragment; unique across the deploy root.

environment.description: Fixed values; ${KEY} refers to the app's env file.

envFile.description: Pass the app's env file to the container.

health.description: image: the image's own HEALTHCHECK; none: running is enough; or a command.

compose.description: Extra compose fields merged into the generated service (the advanced option of design §7.3).

source.description: Package installed through Workbench; absent: the bundle.

settings.description: Package settings; ${KEY} refers to the app's env file.

bind.description: Workbench application the agent is bound to.

package.description: OMA Agent Package definition kept by the Deployer (templates directory, JSON); its strings may name {{system}} (the file above) and the environment settings. Optional, added 2026-10-30 (phase 5).

target.description: Id of the compose-service component running the database.

install.description: Scripts run once on an empty database, in name order.

migrations.description: Directory of ordered migrations; the Deployer records the last one applied.

contract.description: Semantic Contract EDN kept by the Deployer (templates directory); its workspace and graph ids are replaced by the target graph ones. Optional, added 2026-10-30 (phase 5).

when.description: install: only the first deploy to an environment; always: every deploy.
